about_the_game:
The party game where winning mostly means making others fall

Animal Falling is a chaotic multiplayer party game that mixes obstacle racing obstacle racing, player-placed traps, and creative sabotage in a colorful cartoon world ruled by chaos.

Guide your adorable little aniballs to victory while dodging your friends’ traps… or the ones you placed yourself.

How to sabotage a friendship in 3 lessons

1. Place your traps

Strategically place the traps available to you: activate crossbows, turn on giant fans, or plant electric carrots exactly where your rivals least expect them.

The pettier the move, the better.

2. Start the race

The gates open. The furballs are released.

Roll, bounce, and slide through a minefield you helped create yourself. Just don’t be surprised if your own evil genius backfires at the very first turn.

3. Enjoy the fall

Watching your best friend get launched off the map two inches from the finish line creates a deep, guilty laugh that only pure betrayal can deliver.

The frustration is real. The chaos is total. And suddenly, there’s only one thing you want to do: 

Restart the match and get revenge on that traitorous rabbit.

Physically (and mentally) unstable animals

In Animal Falling, gravity is your worst enemy. And it brought friends.

  • Roll, slide, fall: your round animals tumble and bounce in wildly inconsistent ways.

  • Treacherous surfaces: tornadoes that carry you away, icy platforms that steal all control… every turn is a new opportunity to fail spectacularly.

Traps with a mind of their own

Traps are the heart of the game.
Discover a wide variety of tools designed to make your friends rage:

🔨 Spinning hammers that never stop
🪨 Anvils that always fall at the worst possible moment
🥕 Unpredictable electric carrots
🌀 Shady moving platforms you should never trust

Every trap can be combined.
Every setup can backfire.
Every round tells a different story.

Biomes for every taste (and every fall)

🏝️ Tropical Island

Perfect for sending your friends for an unexpected swim in crystal-clear water.

🗻 Snowy Mountain

Ideal for sliding on ice, getting stuck in deep snow, or taking a rock straight to the face.

Play however you want (but play dirty)

  • Local & online multiplayer: play with up to 4 players in split-screen or up to 6 players online.
    The perfect game to spice up game nights… or ruin family dinners.

  • Customization & fancy hats: dress up your furball with ridiculous accessories to stay stylish — even while flying off the map.

Playtest available

Animal Falling is currently in playtest.

This is your chance to:

  • test new features

  • discover new traps and biomes

  • share feedback and shape the game’s development

The community actively influences how the chaos evolves.

Add to your wishlist

If you enjoy:

  • chaotic party games

  • friendly betrayal

  • games that don’t take themselves too seriously

Add Animal Falling to your wishlist. It helps the game a lot.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Animal Falling is a chaotic multiplayer party game where winning often means making sure others don’t. Place traps, sabotage your friends’ runs, and trigger ridiculous falls in a cartoon world built to test your reflexes… and your friendships.
